concepts: inosine short-chain fatty acids LC-MS/MS GC-MS quantification protocol human serum tumor microenvironment reference range

Are there established standardized measurement protocols or consensus guidelines for absolute quantification of inosine and short-chain fatty acids in human cancer patient serum or tumor tissue samples?
gap.question: What standardized analytical protocols (LC-MS/MS or GC-MS parameters, sample processing standards) exist for quantifying absolute physiological concentrations of inosine and short-chain fatty acids in human serum or tumor tissue, and are there cancer-specific reference ranges or consensus statements?
success_criteria: Identification of at least one peer-reviewed methodological paper or consensus guideline specifying: (1) analytical platform parameters for inosine or SCFA quantification in human serum/tumor samples, (2) sample processing standards (extraction, storage), and (3) reference concentration ranges in cancer patients or healthy controls.
gap.user_scope: How does the gut microbiome modulate the efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors in solid tumours, and what mechanisms mediate that effect?
